description: A React Native component implementing a conversation interface with voice and text input, session management, pattern analysis, and avatar animations.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads session data from backend and initializes state.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops audio recording and triggers transcription.

methods.name: transcribeAndAnalyze
methods.description: Transcribes audio file and analyzes text for patterns.

methods.name: analyzeAndAddMessage
methods.description: Sends text for pattern analysis, updates message and pattern states.

methods.name: reevaluatePendingPatterns
methods.description: Re-evaluates pending patterns based on conversation context.

methods.name: handlePatternExonerated
methods.description: Removes exonerated pattern from pending list.

methods.name: handleTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles sending of text message input.

methods.name: toggleSpeaker
methods.description: Switches current speaker between user and other.
